servicesIntro: Routine washes. Full restoration. Protection that holds up in Florida sun and salt.

services.name: Full Detail
services.text: Deep wash, vinyl care, metal polish and hand wax, with compound for oxidation when needed.

services.name: Detail Wash
services.text: A deep wash that removes salt, grime, mold and rust stains from every surface and compartment.

services.name: Wet Sanding
services.text: A 3-step process that removes heavy oxidation and scratches and brings back the gelcoat shine.

services.name: Teak Cleaning and Restoration
services.text: Scrub, brighten and oil to bring back the original color of the wood.

services.name: Gelcoat Repair
services.text: Repair for damaged gelcoat on your boat.

services.name: Bottom Paint Service
services.text: Improves fuel efficiency and makes the hull easier to clean.
